title: UnSAMv2: Self-Supervised Learning Enables Segment Anything at Any Granularity
abstract: arXiv:2511.13714v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) family has become a widely adopted vision foundation model, but its ability to control segmentation granularity remains limited. Users often need to refine results manually - by adding more prompts or selecting from pre-generated masks - to achieve the desired level of detail. This process can be ambiguous, as the same prompt may correspond to several plausible masks, and collecting dense annotations across all granularities is prohibitively expensive, making supervised solutions infeasible. To address this limitation, we introduce UnSAMv2, which can segment anything at any granularity without using any human annotations. UnSAMv2 extends the divide-and-conquer strategy of UnSAM by discovering abundant mask-granularity pairs and introducing a novel granularity control embedding that enables precise, continuous control over segmentation scale. translated_title: UnSAMv2：自监督学习实现任意粒度的万物分割
translated_abstract: Segment Anything Model（SAM）系列已成为被广泛采用的视觉基础模型，但其控制分割粒度的能力仍然有限。用户通常需要手动细化结果——通过添加更多提示或从预生成的掩码中进行选择——才能达到所需的细节级别。这一过程可能存在歧义，因为同一个提示可能对应多个合理的掩码，而且在所有粒度上收集密集标注的成本极其高昂，使得有监督的解决方案不可行。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了 UnSAMv2，它能够在不使用任何人工标注的情况下，以任意粒度对万物进行分割。UnSAMv2 通过发现丰富的掩码-粒度对，并引入一种新颖的粒度控制嵌入来扩展 UnSAM 的分治策略，从而实现对分割尺度的精确、连续控制。值得注意的是，仅需 6K 张无标注图像和 0.02……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: UnSAMv2 通过自监督学习和新颖的粒度控制嵌入，无需任何人工标注即可实现对图像的任意粒度精确分割。
en_tdlr: UnSAMv2 enables segmenting anything at any granularity without any human annotations by leveraging self-supervised learning and a novel granularity control embedding.
